critical_code_review_comments: freebuild_agent.py is 10,593 lines (grew from 10,581) — still well past the 700-line maintainability threshold. The new openrouter_glm branch was correctly added but compounds the existing risk. Continue prior recommendation to extract TOOLS_SCHEMA, _exec_tool dispatcher, and provider stream loops into separate modules.

The provider chain duplicates the env-var gate logic: lines 9040-9042 check keys to decide which provider to push into `providers`, while lines 9242-9260 re-check the same keys inside _stream_one_provider. Acceptable but the source of truth could be centralised — e.g., a small `provider_clients` factory mapping provider-name to a callable that returns an AsyncOpenAI client or raises ProviderUnavailable. Low priority.

Error message at line 9049 still mentions only 'Anthropic / OpenAI / Zhipu' — does not mention OpenRouter. Cosmetic but the user-facing error will be confusing if all keys are missing now that OpenRouter is the primary GLM path. Suggest: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_DIRECT_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY (or ZHIPU_API_KEY)`.

Hard-coded 'https://zenrex.ai' and 'Zenrex FreeBuild' in default_headers (line 9257-9258). Fine as defaults but consider reading from env (OPENROUTER_HTTP_REFERER, OPENROUTER_X_TITLE) so QA/staging deploys can identify themselves. Very low priority.
